list.title: How to Use Summer Essentials trio?
list.content:
1% Salicylic Acid Bodywash
Take adequate amount of bodywash in your palms/loofah. Apply on wet skin in a gentle circular motion.
4% AHA BHA Underarm Roll On
Roll evenly on underarm skin and allow the product to dry completely.
Ultralight Sunscreen
On cleansed and toned skin, apply a generous amount of sunscreen on the face and neck.

list.title: Important Information
list.content:
Patch tests are easy to ensure you don't experience any initial adverse reaction when using a new product. We recommend doing a patch test before starting any new product on your skin. You can conduct a patch test by following the below steps:
1. Apply the product to a small patch of skin either to the arm or bend of the elbow
2. Keep the area dry
3. Leave on for 12-24 hours (or less if the product isn’t a leave-on product)
4. If any redness, itching, or irritation is observed at any time during the test, do not use the product,; you can safely use it

list.title: Is this kit suitable for all skin types?
list.content: Yes, this kit is suitable for all skin types. The 1% Salicylic Acid Bodywash gently exfoliates the skin, leaving it hydrated and refreshed. The 4% AHA BHA Underarm Roll On has no alcohol or aluminium, and is suitable for sensitive skin. The Ultralight Sunscreen is lightweight and suits acne prone skin

list.title: Will the sunscreen leave a white cast?
list.content: Be Bodywise Ultra Light Sunscreen has a lightweight aqua gel like texture and doesn't leave a white cast.

list.title: Does the sunscreen have fragrance?
list.content: No, this sunscreen has no added fragrance.

list.title: Is the bodywash effective against Strawberry Skin?
list.content: Yes, the Salicylic Acid in this gently exfoliates the skin, thereby reducing strawberry skin

list.title: Will the Underarm roll on prevent body odour for long?
list.content: Yes, the 4% AHA BHA Underarm Roll On not only keeps you fresh for 12 hours by killing odour causing bacteria, it also reduces pigmentation in underarms over time.
